notes.title: Official Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
📣 Thank you as always for your support! 

This is an official update from the promotional team.

We’re excited to finally announce the release date for GHOST TRAVELER: Adventures in Edo!

🗓 Release Date: October 16, 2025 (Thursday) JST

💠 Platforms: Steam & Nintendo Switch

 🌐 Languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese

📌CERO: D (17+) 

📌ESRB:MATURE(17+)

In this mystery visual novel, the soul of a high school boy is drawn into Edo‑period Yoshiwara. By possessing the bodies of others and retracing the past, he begins to uncover the truth behind the strange events he encounters.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280110/_Ghost_Traveler/"][/dynamiclink]

🔗 Visit the official GHOST TRAVELER website for more details! And don’t forget to add the game to your Wishlist and share the news on social media.
